Senses.Explanation: Great function or great use. The term occurs 2,094 times in 330 allowlisted texts. Its dominant formula is “great function manifests before you” (大用現前, 447 occurrences in 170 texts), frequently followed by “it does not preserve rules” (不存軌則). In one public interview an unnamed monk asks Changqing Da'an what it is like when great function manifests without preserving rules. Changqing answers, “if you can use it, then use it” (汝用得但用); the monk bares his shoulder and is struck. Another unnamed monk asks Shanhui separately, “what is great capacity?” and “what is great function?” and receives a blow across the back for each. The corpus coordinates “great capacity and great function” (大機大用, 276 occurrences) and “the whole capacity and great function” (全機大用, 115 occurrences). Yuanwu Keqin uses the first pairing in instruction to Deshan Jing and the second while describing meeting life with life and death with death. Guishan Lingyou supplies an explicit contrast: “you people have obtained only the great body, not great function” (汝等諸人只得大體不得大用). Yangshan Huiji identifies Baizhang Huaihai with great capacity and Huangbo Xiyun with great function. Xuansha Shibei asks Xuefeng Yicun what it is like when great function manifests, and Xuefeng rolls three balls together. These formulas, questions, bodily replies, pairings, and contrasts show a function publicly displayed and appraised in encounters; they do not establish a separate metaphysical object behind the term.
Senses.Note: No distinct referent emerged from 'great function' (大用), 'great function manifests before you' (大用現前), 'great capacity and great function' (大機大用), 'the whole capacity and great function' (全機大用), and the 'great body/great function' (大體/大用) comparison. 'Use' and 'function' are alternate English readings of the same attested thing, not separate senses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問。大用現前．不存軌則時如何。師曰。汝用得但用。僧乃脫膊。遶師三匝。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Compendium (五燈會元), Changqing Da'an section. An unnamed monk is the exact questioner who asks, ‘when great function appears before you and does not preserve rules, what then?’; Changqing Da'an answers, ‘if you can use it, just use it.’ The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage search do not give the monk a personal name.

Occurrences.Kwic: 夫參學眼目。臨機直須大用現前。莫自拘於小節。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Eyes of Humans and Gods (人天眼目): Huiyan Zhizhao quotes Fengxue Yanzhao's instruction that at an encounter one must have great function manifest before one and not constrain oneself by minor particulars.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問：「如何是大機？」師劈脊便打。進云：「如何是大用？」師劈脊便打。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shanhui (山暉禪師語錄), public exchange in Shanhui's record. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: after asking what great capacity is and receiving a blow across the back, he advances and asks what great function is, receiving another blow. The six-rung review found no personal name for this monk.

Occurrences.Kwic: 溈山上堂云汝等諸人只得大體不得大用師抽身出去溈山召之師更不迴顧
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Jade Flowers Collection from the Transmission of the Lamp, fragment (傳燈玉英集（殘卷）), section on Yangshan Huiji: Guishan Lingyou tells the assembly that they have obtained only the great body and not great function.

Occurrences.Kwic: 溈山云馬祖出八十四人善知識幾人得大機幾人得大用仰山云百丈得大機黃檗得大用
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of the Ancient Worthies (古尊宿語錄), a Guishan Lingyou–Yangshan Huiji exchange preserved in Baizhang Huaihai's record: Yangshan Huiji calls the raised-whisk encounter a display of great capacity and great function, then says Baizhang obtained great capacity and Huangbo Xiyun obtained great function; Guishan's intervening question repeats the term.

Occurrences.Kwic: 舉：玄沙問雪峰：大用現前時如何？雪峰以三毬一齊輥動。玄沙作斫牌勢，
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Jue'an Kexiang (絕岸可湘禪師語錄): Xuansha Shibei asks Xuefeng Yicun, ‘When great function manifests before you, how is it?’ Xuefeng responds by rolling three balls together; Jue'an Kexiang later raises and comments on the exchange.

Occurrences.Kwic: 從上來莫不皆以是大機大用，龍象蹴蹋，非驢所堪。若不具此手段，云何與人解黏去縛，抽釘拔楔？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Essentials of Chan Master Foguo Keqin (佛果克勤禪師心要), instruction to Deshan Jing: Yuanwu Keqin calls the inherited work great capacity and great function and says that without this ability one cannot unstick people or pull out their pegs and wedges.

Occurrences.Kwic: 古人到這境界。全機大用。遇生與爾同生。遇死與爾同死。向虎口裏橫身。放得手脚。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄): Yuanwu Keqin says that the ancients at this point had the whole capacity and great function, meeting life with life and death with death and putting themselves across a tiger's mouth.
